items.title: Resettling disaster survivors takes more than finding them new homes
items.blurb: Past relocation schemes have left families in unsafe settlements or driven them home. A 55-year-old settlement in Kanchanpur offers lessons as the government plans to relocate Bhotekoshi flood survivors.

items.title: Months after Bhotekoshi floods, families still await bodies and closure
items.blurb: DNA matches alone cannot establish which missing family member the recovered remains belong to, and this has delayed identification and the return of bodies.

items.title: Lack of verified data delays scholarships for flood-hit students
items.blurb: Nearly three months after the Bhotekoshi catastrophe, the government has approved scholarships for 27 students, but the number of other children who lost their parents or homes remains unknown.

items.title: Salyan to reassess 756 earthquake-hit households
items.blurb: Repeated assessments have delayed relief and reconstruction for earthquake survivors in Darma Rural Municipality, where 1,600 households have yet to receive even the first instalment of government assistance.

items.title: Three seasons, three finals—Sudurpaschim Royals do it again
items.blurb: The Royals defeated Chitwan Rhinos in Qualifier 2 on Thursday to book a seat in the final for the third consecutive season.

items.title: Sudurpaschim reach third straight NPL final, set up title clash with Lumbini
items.blurb: Tharindu Ratnayake’s unbeaten 53 guides Sudurpaschim Royals to a three-wicket victory over Chitwan Rhinos in Qualifier 2.

items.title: At Seto Gumba, there’s more to being a nun than prayer and meditation
items.blurb: Over 80 Buddhist nuns at the monastery in western Kathmandu blend daily kung fu practice with meditation, disaster relief, environmental advocacy, and skills traditionally associated with men.
